name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
description: The scandalous world of a group of Mormon mom influencers implodes when they get caught in the midst of a swinging sex scandal that makes international headlines. Now, their sisterhood is shook to its core. Faith, friendship and reputations are all on the line. Will #MomTok be able to survive and continue to give the rulebook a run for its money, or will this group fall from grace?

videos.title: The First Book of Taylor
videos.overview: After the #MomTok swinging scandal goes viral worldwide, a shocking turn of events changes Taylor Frankie Paul's life forever. Whitney comes back from exile and more secrets are revealed rocking #MomTok to its core.

videos.title: The Book of Belonging
videos.overview: Allegiances are tested as a new Queen Bee of #MomTok declares herself. A provocative brand deal for Whitney brings religion vs. sexuality front and center.

videos.title: The Book of Saints & Sinners
videos.overview: When one of the ladies commits a 'sin' at a conservative party, the group is torn in two as they battle over the right identity for #MomTok.

videos.title: The Book of Truth
videos.overview: A birthday trip goes wild after a scandalous game forces out the truth. Taylor finally confronts Whitney, leading one of them to question if they want to continue in #MomTok at all.

videos.title: The Book of Broken Vows
videos.overview: Taylor reveals her true feelings about a future with Dakota, Layla celebrates her divorce, and a new leader is nominated in Whitney's absence.

videos.title: The First Book of Sin
videos.overview: A wild trip to Sin City tests faith, friendship, and puts marriages in jeopardy.

videos.title: The Book of Trust
videos.overview: After an explosive trip to Sin City, Mayci confesses a life altering secret to Taylor, Jen tries to save her marriage, and #MomTok tries to save Jen.

videos.title: The Book of Rumors
videos.overview: Dakota confronts Mayci, an unexpected guest makes a splash, and the girls' futures with #MomTok are on the line in this explosive season finale.

videos.title: The Book of Revelations
videos.overview: #MomTok's world is rocked when Miranda arrives and challenges Taylor's truth about the swinging scandal. Taylor finally meets with Jenna to learn what really happened between her and Dakota, and Jen must make a decision about her future with Zac.

videos.title: The Book of Accountability
videos.overview: #MomTok gathers for an explosive Halloween party with key players from the swinging scandal on the guest list. Taylor's self-worth is tested when her dad makes a cutting remark about her past, and Jen gets caught in lies.

videos.title: The Book of Retribution
videos.overview: The truth about the swinging scandal is finally revealed when Taylor confronts Miranda. Jen receives devastating news that further complicates her relationship with Zac, and Mikayla opens a painful chapter from her past.

videos.title: The Book of Taboos
videos.overview: #MomTok's provocative party challenges the church's view on sex and helps Layla reach the big O. A shocking Sinner Sunday Confession about Demi and Bret's marriage is revealed, and Jen deals with repercussions for lies of which she's been accused.

videos.title: The Book of Divisions
videos.overview: The group begins to splinter as Jessi and Jen face off. Whitney confronts Mikayla, and Jen makes claims about Demi. Alliances form as the women battle over #MomTok and for what it truly stands.

videos.title: The Book of Redemption
videos.overview: A secret about Demi is exposed on a girls' trip to Scottsdale, bringing her true colors into question. Whitney attempts to make right by the girls, and Jen questions her future with the group.

videos.title: The Book of Gratitude
videos.overview: As #MomTok prepares to compete in the first-ever Great Mormon Bakeoff, personal relationships are challenged. Demi questions if there is truth to the confession about Bret; Layla faces issues with Cam, and Taylor is at a crossroads with Dakota.

videos.title: The Book of Betrayal
videos.overview: Another online scandal devastates #MomTok after Taylor presents at the CMA Awards. World War III erupts between Taylor and Demi, and Mayci gets life-changing news.

videos.title: The Book of Reckoning
videos.overview: A fun girls' trip to New Orleans turns into a mission to excise the cancer that is destroying the soul of #MomTok. Demi threatens a shocking ultimatum, and Taylor makes a decision about her future with Dakota.

videos.title: The Book of Salvation
videos.overview: The future of #MomTok is hanging by a thread when the girls are put to the ultimate test of loyalty, leading to goodbyes for good. A fresh scandal explodes when a jaw-dropping secret comes to light. Will the truth set #MomTok free?

videos.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Reunion Special
videos.overview: After a shocking end to season 2, host Nick Viall reunites all of #MomTok and #DadTok to uncover secrets and scandals, never-before-seen footage, and a surprise announcement in the first-ever reunion special for "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives."

videos.title: The Book of Doubt
videos.overview: Scandal rocks #MomTok when accusations of a secret affair threaten relationships. Layla invites an unwelcome guest to a #MomTok party, and Demi and Whitney lurk in the shadows.

videos.title: The Book of Fidelity
videos.overview: As a marriage unravels, Mikayla and Mayci set out to learn the truth about an affair. Taylor commits to new boundaries with Dakota, and Jen anxiously makes her return to Utah.

videos.title: The Book of Demi
videos.overview: #MomTok learns that Demi may have been involved in exposing Jessi. Demi makes an unexpected appearance and goes head-to-head with Layla, and Jen nervously gears up for her reunion with the girls.

videos.title: The Book of Deceit
videos.overview: In the wake of a lie detector test, a toxic dynamic comes to light, creating a war between #MomTok and #DadTok. Jen returns to the group with a score to settle, and Layla's hair loss motivates her to make a big change.

videos.title: The Book of Resurrection
videos.overview: The group's newfound peace is threatened when the ghost of #MomTok’s past returns in the form of Whitney, and reputations are publicly attacked. Mikayla confronts her painful past.

videos.title: The Book of Confrontation
videos.overview: As #MomTok heads to Hollywood, a shocking allegation is made. The wedge between the group deepens, and Jessi and Demi face off.

videos.title: The Book of Broken Hearts
videos.overview: #MomTok saddles up for Stagecoach, but their weekend takes a turn when a damning post threatens to destroy the group. Marital issues worsen while others rekindle romance.

videos.title: The Book of Awakening
videos.overview: Headlines make waves in Utah and suspicious receipts leave allegiances in question. Pieces of the past come to light, and a devastating secret is revealed.

videos.title: The Book of Judgement
videos.overview: A glitzy premiere goes off the rails, when behind the scenes drama erupts during press.

videos.title: The Book of Enlightenment
videos.overview: Righteous or revelatory? A shocking intervention calls for both the hot seat and the Holy Ghost.

videos.title: Season 3 Reunion Special
videos.overview: 'Tis the season for the most dramatic reunion yet! Host Stassi Schroeder reunites #MomTok and #DadTok to explore the shocking scandals, uncover never-before-seen footage, and deck the halls with controversial guests in the Season 3 Reunion.

videos.title: The Book of Taking Flight
videos.overview: As #MomTok sends two off to "Dancing with the Stars," a shocking return to "Vanderpump Villa" rocks the ladies' marriages. Taylor makes a bold move. Jessi hits her limits with Jordan.

videos.title: The Book of Secrets
videos.overview: Taylor is offered the opportunity of a lifetime as The Bachelorette, but #MomTok questions her new crush. Jessi and Demi attempt to reconcile. Spilled secrets detonate the group's peace.

videos.title: The Book of True Colors
videos.overview: Old wounds resurface and #MomTok must confront one member's duplicity. A revelation sends Taylor spiraling, while Mayci and Mikayla seek to settle the score with Chase once and for all.

videos.title: The Book of Exodus
videos.overview: When #MomTok travels to LA, dynamics shift as one member exits and another's place is cemented. Taylor struggles with her past, and #MomTok gets a surprise visit from Harry Jowsey.

videos.title: The Book of Power and Pain
videos.overview: A discovery rocks #MomTok and their marriages but unifies them in a common goal. Taylor examines her toxic patterns. A slight against Mayci raises questions about priorities and loyalties.

videos.title: The Book of Conceit
videos.overview: Torn between success and sacrifice, #Momtok reaches a breaking point as they juggle family, fame, and friendships. Tensions erupt in Taylor's family, leading to a shocking revelation.

videos.title: The Book of Fragile Egos
videos.overview: As cracks in #MomTok's marriages deepen, the ladies challenge the men to an epic pickleball battle. Jen follows her dreams in Los Angeles, but Zac struggles to survive as a stay-at-home dad.

videos.title: The Book of Unearthing
videos.overview: When betrayal rocks #MomTok, they are forced to decide whether or not to hide the truth. Taylor and her mom travel to their old hometown to uncover the root of Taylor's abandonment wounds.

videos.title: The Book of Coveting
videos.overview: Fury is unleashed as lines are crossed in #Momtok. Mikayla must make a life-altering decision. Frenemies face off, and security is shaken with millions of dollars at stake.

videos.title: The Book of Thorns and Roses
videos.overview: An exploding riff threatens to tear #Momtok apart. A harrowing addiction comes to light, and a spectacular no-show leaves everyone scrambling.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 nomination total
